notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on Sporoloth Ancient due to Brad Boimler.
Activate Sporoloth Ancient by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token plus an additional creature token due to Chatterfang.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 1.
